name: cachly-brain
description: Persistent memory for AI coding assistants over MCP. Your assistant remembers the bug you fixed, why you chose Postgres, and which earlier decision a new one contradicts — across sessions, editors, and models. Hosted in the EU, free tier available.

instance_id.title: Brain instance ID
instance_id.description: The UUID of your cachly brain. Create one free at https://cachly.dev/sign-up — it is shown right after sign-up and in the dashboard. Set it with /plugin configure cachly-brain@cachly. Until you do, the server starts and answers, but has no brain to talk to.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your cachly API key (starts with cky_). Found in the dashboard under API keys. Leave empty to run against a local Redis instead.
